recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14745 unless a future work-group decision reopens FHIR-46960 or changes the Event-pattern wording.
issue_request: FHIR-14745 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy STU3 change request asking to improve MedicationAdministration.performer.function because the old description, "Who performed the administration and what they did," described the performer backbone/actor rather than the function; the final resolution was to change the description and definition to match workflow.
initial_application: Jira records application in commit 73c779d3aeb5a6120955eb499d67727c2fdfdf47. That commit changed the MedicationAdministration spreadsheet source for performer.function from the stale who-performed wording to "Type of performance" and "Distinguishes the type of involvement of the performer in the medication administration," while separately clarifying performer and performer.actor.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current StructureDefinition keeps performer.function as a CodeableConcept with short "Type of performance," a type-of-involvement definition, and a role-oriented binding description. The Event pattern uses the same short text for Event.performer.function. Later same-element issue FHIR-46960 was Resolved - No Change / Not Persuasive because Pharmacy wanted to keep the Event-inherited wording in sync.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative source no longer has the stale "who performed" description on performer.function and remains consistent with both the original applied clarification and the later no-change decision.
